title: encrypt() doc says Other("no recipients"), returns NoRecipients
description: encrypt.rs line 93: doc comment says 'Returns SmimeError::Other("no recipients") when recipients is empty' but the code actually returns SmimeError::NoRecipients (added in a prior review pass). A caller who reads the doc and writes 'match err { SmimeError::Other(_) => ... }' will silently miss the empty-recipients error. Correct the doc comment to reference SmimeError::NoRecipients.
